user.title: Add AI Web Quota Integration
user.description:
Configure the data source, provider, and authentication parameters.

**CLIProxy**: Uses provider auth index from your CLIProxy account
**Trouter**: Requires API key from Trouter.click
**9Router**: Requires password and base URL (e.g., http://192.168.1.107:20128)

data_description.auth_index: Authentication index (0, 1, 2, etc.) - Used to differentiate multiple accounts
data_description.account_name: Optional: Display name for this account
data_description.api_key: For Trouter: API Key | For 9Router: Password
data_description.proxy_url: For CLIProxy: API endpoint | For 9Router: Base URL (e.g., http://192.168.1.107:20128 or https://ai.wolfz.shop)

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to data source
error.api_key_required: API Key is required for Trouter

abort.already_configured: This provider with the same auth index is already configured
